summary:
Main
The earlier recovery did not persist, with futures, port prices and seaborne quotations weakening together today. DCE most-traded fell 1.47%to 672.0 yuan/mt, while all eight Qingdao products declined 10 yuan/wmt. The 61%, 58% and 65% port indices were 650, 602 and 812 yuan/wmt; the seaborne 61% and 65% indices were USD 90.50 and 106.75/dmt.
